entities.name: Hakbal of the Surging Soul
entities.description: A merfolk scout, aqualogist and leader of the River Heralds' vanguard on Ixalan.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Merfolk exploration corps that took refuge underground during the invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which the Heralds went underground.

events.summary: The River Heralds, unable to defeat the invaders, seek ancient paths underground to hide.
events.quote: they elected to seek ancient paths underground

events.summary: Hakbal leads the first group into the dark caverns and the Heralds find safety, preserving Ixalan's memory.
events.quote: Hakbal, using his magic and wits, led the first group down into the dark caverns.
